source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the pinned like, present sing and restricted learning.
key_decisions.before: and they were singing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and before the elders. And no one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.
key_decisions.after: They sing what is like a new song before the throne, the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been bought from the earth.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and they were singing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and before the elders. And no one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the specifically gendered sexual image and purchase/firstfruits language without interpreting them away.
key_decisions.before: These are the ones who have not defiled themselves with women, for they are pure. These are the ones who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These have been redeemed from among mankind as firstfruits for God and the Lamb,
key_decisions.after: These are the ones who have not defiled themselves with women, for they are virgins. These are the ones who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were bought from humanity as firstfruits for God and the Lamb,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: These are the ones who have not defiled themselves with women, for they are pure. These are the ones who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These have been redeemed from among mankind as firstfruits for God and the Lamb,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the repeated fallen and wine/sexual imagery; the passion/wrath range is noted.
key_decisions.before: Another angel, a second, followed, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, she who has made all nations drink the wine of the passion of her immorality.”
key_decisions.after: Another angel, a second, followed, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, who made all the nations drink the wine of the passion of her prostitution!”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Another angel, a second, followed, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, she who has made all nations drink the wine of the passion of her immorality.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves full-strength wine and torment with both witnessing groups.
key_decisions.before: he also will drink the wine of the wrath of God, poured unmixed into the cup of his anger, and he will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.
key_decisions.after: that person too will drink the wine of God's fury, poured full strength into the cup of his wrath, and will be tormented with fire and sulfur before the holy angels and before the Lamb.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: he also will drink the wine of the wrath of God, poured unmixed into the cup of his anger, and he will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the genitive faith of Jesus with its interpretive alternatives in the note.
key_decisions.before: Here is a call for the endurance of the saints, people who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
key_decisions.after: Here is the endurance of the holy ones, those who keep God's commands and the faith of Jesus.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Here is a call for the endurance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the writing command, from-now-on phrase, named Spirit and labor/works contrast.
key_decisions.before: And I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write this: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow them.”
key_decisions.after: I heard a voice from heaven say, “Write: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “they will rest from their labors, for their works follow them.”
